candidates.title: Will Lorenzo Sonego win at least 1.5 more games than Alejandro Tabilo?

candidates.rules_secondary:
The following market refers to the Lorenzo Sonego vs Alejandro Tabilo professional tennis match in the 2026 ATP Stockholm Round Of 16.
